title: Print Navbar Footer Chip Edge Alignment
description: Fix navbar/footer chips in print/tex/semio-window.sty rendering with inward horizontal offset instead of flush against the chrome border. Top-left chip (emblem/project) must start exactly where the border starts, top-right chip (heading) must end exactly where the border ends — same for footer (logo chips left, page number right). Remove the extraneous \hspace{\semio@spacing@single} padding at both ends of \semio@chrome@bar@threezone's edge hbox that currently offsets the whole chip row inward from \headwidth.
